title: Revit to Navisworks Export Instruction
purpose: Provide repeatable Revit export actions for producing traceable Navisworks coordination artifacts while preserving governed model identity, spatial alignment, required properties, and export evidence.
preconditions: The model identity has been declared and validated.
The model has reached the applicable coordination-ready state.
The governing shared-coordinate method has been established and validated where spatial federation applies.
Required governed properties and parameters are available for the intended coordination use.
An approved export configuration exists or the project has an explicitly governed manual configuration basis.

steps.name: Select the governed Navisworks export configuration
steps.purpose: Prevent ad-hoc or inconsistent export settings.
actions: Open the applicable Navisworks export settings in Revit.
Select the approved export preset when a governed preset exists; otherwise configure only from the applicable governed project standard.
Confirm and record the exporter version used.
validation: Export settings match the applicable governed configuration basis.
Exporter version is recorded in the export evidence.
failure_modes: User-defined settings are used without governed authorization.

steps.name: Configure geometry and element conversion
steps.purpose: Preserve required coordination geometry without unnecessary duplication or weight.
preconditions: Applicable export configuration has been selected.
actions: Configure element conversion according to the applicable governed coordination scope.
Exclude element categories only where the governing coordination requirement permits exclusion.
Apply the governed tessellation and detail settings when those settings are explicitly defined.
validation: A test open or equivalent inspection confirms required geometry is present.
No unintended element loss or duplication is observed.
failure_modes: Export geometry is unnecessarily heavy for the declared coordination use.

steps.name: Configure governed coordinates and positioning
steps.purpose: Preserve spatial alignment across federated coordination models.
preconditions: The project shared-coordinate system is established and validated.
actions: Configure the export to use the governed shared-coordinate basis.
Do not substitute an alternate local-origin or base-point method where S6 shared coordinates govern federation.
Record the coordinate method used in the export evidence.
validation: The exported model aligns with the governed project spatial framework.
No unexplained translation or rotation is observed during federation.

steps.name: Configure property and data export
steps.purpose: Expose the governed information needed for coordination and issue management without exporting uncontrolled data by default.
preconditions: Required governed parameters are defined and populated for the intended coordination use.
actions: Enable export of properties required by the applicable coordination and information requirements.
Exclude redundant or non-governed property groups only where that exclusion does not remove required information.
Verify required property visibility in a test export or equivalent inspection.
validation: Required governed properties are visible in the exported coordination artifact.
No required information is silently omitted.
Information outside the declared coordination need is not exposed solely by convenience where restrictions apply.
failure_modes: Export contains excessive uncontrolled data clutter.
Restricted information is exposed contrary to project governance.

steps.name: Execute export and record evidence
steps.purpose: Produce a traceable coordination artifact and auditable export record.
preconditions: Applicable export settings have been validated.
actions: Name the exported artifact using the applicable governed identity rule.
Record export date, exporter version, coordinate method, and configuration or preset identity where available.
Open or validate the exported artifact before coordination use.
validation: The exported artifact opens successfully in the intended coordination environment.
The exported artifact identity can be related back to its governed source container.

outputs: A Navisworks-readable coordination artifact suitable for the declared coordination use.
A traceable export record containing the applicable exporter, coordinate, and configuration context.
A validated relationship between the exported artifact and its governed source model identity.
evidence: Export configuration or settings snapshot where available.
Export log or equivalent audit record.
Federation or test-open evidence demonstrating geometry and coordinate alignment where applicable.
future_dependencies: A concrete governed Export Preset Registry is not yet migrated; the source explicitly treats it as future work.
Exact exporter option values must not be invented from the higher-level narrative source and should be added only from a governed configuration source.
governance_notes: Navisworks exports are coordination artifacts and do not become contractual deliverables merely because they exist; formal exchange status remains governed by S7.
This instruction executes S5/S6/S7/S8 requirements and does not redefine coordinate, semantic, acceptance, or tool authority.

provenance.migration_note: Normalized from the source machine-readable instruction set. Source workflow labels are retained only through provenance context; future preset-registry dependencies remain unresolved and no exact export values were invented.
